title: Unique balanced action on a single affine open
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings with an $A$-algebra structure on $B$, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $M$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\rho:B\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal O_X}(M)$ be a unital ring map whose $A$-action agrees with multiplication by $f^\sharp(a)$ for all $a\in A$. Put $Y=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B$, with projections $\pi,f_B$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For each fixed affine open $U$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis], there is a unique unital ring map $\tau:\mathcal O_Y(\pi^{-1}U)\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf Z}(M(U))$ such that $\tau(\pi^\sharp(d))(x)=dx$ for all $d,x$, and $\tau(f_B^\sharp(b)|_{\pi^{-1}U})(x)=\rho(b)_U(x)$ for all $b,x$. The assertion concerns only this single open and makes no claim of restriction compatibility.

proof.text: Evaluate rho at U to obtain a ring map to additive endomorphisms of M(U), and use Module.toAddMonoidEnd for scalar multiplication by O_X(U). Each image commutes internally; the mixed images commute because the evaluated endomorphisms are O_X(U)-linear. Subring.isMulCommutative_closure therefore gives a commutative ring containing both images.

Corestrict both actions to that commutative subring and use Scheme.ΓSpecIso for B on the second factor. The scalar hypothesis evaluated at U and Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality imply the two maps agree over Γ(Spec A,top). Apply the affine pushout-section theorem with U and the two top opens, and descend to the generated subring, then include into additive endomorphisms. The two desc equations give the specified factor identities.

For any competing action, apply affineBaseChange_sections_induction to the predicate that the two actions agree on every module element. The generator cases are the specified identities; addition and multiplication preserve agreement because both actions are ring maps. Extensionality proves uniqueness.

theorem balancedAction_affine_open
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (M : X.Modules) (_hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (rho : B →+* End M)
    (hscalar : ∀ a : A, rho (algebraMap A B a) =
      M.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a))
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f g
    let pi : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    let fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B) := pullback.snd f g
    let C := (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} pi.base).obj Y.sheaf
    ∃! tau : C.obj.obj (op U.val) →+* AddMonoid.End (M.val.obj (op U.val)),
      (∀ (r : X.presheaf.obj (op U.val)) (x : M.val.obj (op U.val)),
        tau (pi.app U.val r) x = r • x) ∧
      (∀ (b : B) (x : M.val.obj (op U.val)),
        tau (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := pi ⁻¹ᵁ U.val))).op
          (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b)) x =
            (rho b).val.app (op U.val) x)
